title: Pre-K Admissions Guide: Age Requirements, State Eligibility Bases and the Instructional Day
content:
Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the two Pre-Kindergarten types set the age a child must reach, the cutoff date for reaching it and whether a state eligibility basis must be on file. The table also gives the length of the instructional day for every type.

| Enrollment type | Age to be reached by the cutoff, per Pre-K grade | Cutoff date (in the year the school year starts) | A state Pre-K eligibility basis must be on file | State eligibility bases accepted (Texas Education Code 29.153) | A child admitted to PK3 on a basis stays eligible for PK4 the next school year | Instructional day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | none | not applicable | no | none | no | full day |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | none | not applicable | no | none | no | full day |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | none | not applicable | no | none | no | full day |
| Non-Resident Transfer | none | not applicable | no | none | no | full day |
| Choice Program Enrollment | none | not applicable | no | none | no | full day |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | PK3: 3 years; PK4: 4 years | 09-01 (1 September) | yes | emergent bilingual; free or reduced-price meals; homeless; military-connected; foster care; Star of Texas family | yes | full day |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | PK4: 4 years | 09-01 (1 September) | no | none | no | full day |

## Age at the cutoff (hypothetical birth dates)

The age is reached on or before the cutoff. For a school year starting in a hypothetical year 2031:
- a child born on 1 September 2027 turns 4 on 1 September 2031, on the cutoff itself, and so meets the PK4 age;
- a child born on 2 September 2027 turns 4 one day after the cutoff and does not meet the PK4 age that school year;
- a child born on 15 March 2028 turns 3 before the cutoff and meets the PK3 age, which only Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) admits.
